title: Piccolo players and absence of accordions
summary: Piccolo players such as Doc Monique were few; accordions were not used.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Ask if they used a piccolo in the old bands in the street. Piccolo.
Did they use the piccolos in the old bands on the street?
Yeah, there wasn't much of them. There was. Till now, do you know Till now? You know? No. He was a piccolo player. And who else?
Bad Frank. And who else? Who was the other fella? Bad Frank.
I'm thinking about the name. What's the name? Actually, it was Bad Frank. Was it Bad Frank? No. Doc Monique. You know Doc Monique? Doc Monique.
He used to play piccolo. You know? You never know him, no.
He's a good musician. He's a good musician. Any other questions, Dick, you can think of? Or Paul? Ask him if you know any accordion players today.
You know any accordion players? Oh, I know.
They didn't use any accordion players.
